title: healthrelay.catalog-product-version v1
description: One published version of one catalog product, as the public catalog serves it. Deny by default: every object level is closed, so any field that is not listed here - and nothing that identifies a person, a device or an intake - is refused. Amounts are exact decimal strings, never JSON numbers. Value states mirror the iOS NutrientValue cases.

version.description: Monotonic version of this product record, starting at 1.

barcodes.description: Barcodes this product is known by. Digits only, no check-digit interpretation.

status.description: Only published records are part of v1. Draft, pending and withdrawn records are never served.

productId.description: Catalog-internal product identifier, opaque to clients.

decimalString.description: An exact decimal: an optional minus, digits, optional fractional digits. No exponent, no thousands comma, no NaN, no infinity, no empty string, and never a JSON number.

unitSymbol.description: A unit symbol from contracts/nutrients/registry.v1.json. Anything else is an unknown unit symbol.

serving.description: The serving the nutrient values below are stated for.

nutrientMap.description: Nutrient values keyed by registry nutrient id. Only known, unknown, not_applicable and below_reporting_threshold values may appear.

nutrientValue.description: A nutrient amount and its state. Only the known state carries an amount; the other three never do.

nutrientUnknown.description: The provider does not state this nutrient for this product.

nutrientNotApplicable.description: This nutrient does not apply to this product at all.

nutrientBelowReportingThreshold.description: Present but under the provider's reporting threshold. The unit is optional, because a provider may report the state without one.

source.description: Where the record came from and under what licence it may be reused. Every record states its licence.

name.description: Provider key, for example usda_fdc, dsld or open_food_facts.

licence.description: SPDX-style licence identifier of the source data.

attribution.description: The credit line the licence requires. Safe to show to a user; never a person or an account.

url.description: Public https page describing the source record.
